Since imports can be triggered by feed polling (Jobs::PollFeed) for arbitrary feed URLs, a URL with no matching EmbeddableHost row yields `nil` category, falling back to uncategorized instead of the previously configurable embed_category. This behavioral regression is directly grounded in the changed line; whether the maintainer considers it intentional is unresolved, so moderate confidence.

adjudication.rationale: In `app/models/topic_embed.rb`, `TopicEmbed.import` now sets `category: eh.try(:category_id)` after `eh = EmbeddableHost.record_for_host(url)`. If no `EmbeddableHost` matches the URL host, `eh` is nil and the category passed to `PostCreator` becomes nil. The diff also removes the `embed_category` site setting, so there is no longer a fallback category. There is no host-allow check inside `TopicEmbed.import` to prevent such imports or to default the category, so imports for non-configured hosts can silently create topics without the intended category (likely falling back to uncategorized/default behavior).
